input.customer_message: @MicrosoftHelps We have tried that. How do you explain 3 failed products in two years?! Do you think that is adequate? Is that your ethos for treating customers? There are many of us in this position, hence you stopping production. You should therefore treat people fairly. As your title implies
input.conversation_context:
MICROSOFT (2633859): @743642 Hello Keith. We wanted to help you as much as we can with regard to your Micorsoft Band problem. Can you send us the care number for your conversation with our Support team via DM?
CUSTOMER (2633860): @MicrosoftHelps @743642 We were not offered a care number. Just very rude, no apology for the 3 defunct bands in TWO YEARS! I am £199 out of pocket. No offer of help, or recognition of the 3 failed products. Disgusting. Very upset.
CUSTOMER (2633861): @MicrosoftHelps ...3rd ms band in 3 years....each one has failed. Called the support line & no help whatsoever; clearly the product is not fit for purpose and I'm out of pocket...not happy; why such bad customer service??????
MICROSOFT (2633862): @743643 Hi Faith. Let's investigate further. Can you tell us what issue you're having on your Microsoft Band?
CUSTOMER (2633863): @MicrosoftHelps So what can you do to make this right for me? Can understand why production has stopped, but many people have had problems, are out of pocket and have been treated unfairly. I just want you to be fair https://t.co/euBdAMMfTy
MICROSOFT (2633864): @743643 We hear you, Faith. Were there any recommendations provided to you by our support team? Please see this link: https://t.co/XZTyJNOPit for more information regarding Microsoft Band warranty coverage. https://t.co/3qcAsLFkaY
CUSTOMER (2633865): @MicrosoftHelps So what are you doing to make this right? Bearing in mind this is the third Microsoft Band in two years, every one failing.
MICROSOFT (2633866): @743643 We appreciate your response. We suggest that you visit the nearest Microsoft Store in your area or contact Global Customer Support for further assistance. You'll find the phone number for your country/region here: https://t.co/OvqCUhuC0S
